findings.impact: deny rules may render but not isolate traffic
findings.remaining_risk: hosted cluster CNI remains unverified until hosted staging
findings.remediation: use a NetworkPolicy-enforcing CNI for the staging audit cluster
findings.reproduction: run staging audit on a cluster without NetworkPolicy-enforcing CNI
findings.root_cause: Kind default CNI does not enforce Kubernetes NetworkPolicy

findings.evidence: OutboxWorker drains event_outbox and event_bus_outbox; domains and schemas differ
findings.remaining_risk: consumer-level contract tests for all EventBus topics remain future work
findings.remediation: document intentional separation and verify both relay paths in deployment evidence
findings.reproduction: inspect backend/src/workers/outbox-worker.ts and publish tests for both domains
findings.root_cause: two intentional event domains share a worker but not a schema

findings.evidence: staging harness uses Redpanda while production Helm may use Kafka
findings.impact: local-real evidence proves Kafka protocol integration, not vendor-specific Kafka packaging
findings.remaining_risk: managed/hosted Kafka remains unverified until hosted staging
findings.remediation: use Redpanda as the local Kafka-compatible broker and keep hosted Kafka unverified
findings.root_cause: Confluent cp-kafka was unstable in Kind on the local architecture during audit
